title.zh: Polymarket推出Protocol V2，重构现有协议底层架构
title.en: Polymarket推出Protocol V2，重构现有协议底层架构

current_state.zh: Polymarket unveiled Protocol V2, a rebuilt modular smart-contract system using a unified ERC1155 position token, pUSD collateral, an OracleAggregator for UMA/Chainlink, and native cross-chain settlement, with a staged migration to new markets beginning November 2 after multi-firm audits and formal verification.
